unit: Allen Discovery Center at Tufts University

labs.lab_name: Allen Discovery Center at Tufts University
labs.research_summary: Studies bioelectric signaling and collective intelligence in biological systems, including morphogenesis, regeneration and basal cognition, funded by the Paul G. Allen Frontiers Group.
labs.member_breakdown: 1 PI, 1 Center Deputy Director (Robert M. Brucker), ~17 staff/affiliate/research scientists. Excludes 11 'Founding Members' who are external collaborating PIs at other institutions (e.g. Harvard, Princeton), not Tufts-based center staff.
labs.notes: Michael Levin's primary departmental appointment is Biology (see tufts-biology.json) and he is also an Investigator in tufts-insciDE.json -- this entry is specifically the Allen Discovery Center, a distinct funded center with its own large staff roster, not a duplicate.
